description: [provider] Search states and provinces. Searches states by name or country codes — returns up to 100 states per page (CompanyEnrich · Company data) (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

inputSchema.description: FREE. Returns numeric state `id`s — those integers, not the names, are what the `states` filter on company search takes.

countryCodes.description: ISO alpha-2 codes to scope the search

query.description: state or province name; prefixes DO work here ('cali' matched California)

name: companyenrich_geo_states_search
